title: DO NOT OPEN · Protocol
description: The protocol on one network: collection, pending proofs, indexer, RPC pool, API replicas and traffic, side services, the mainnet whitelist, the sealed vault, the studio. Public facts and counts only.

panels.title: Requests waiting for their KMS proof, by kind
panels.description: Openings, alive checks, entanglements, duels and milestones whose decryption proof was not submitted yet.

panels.title: Oldest pending request (blocks)
panels.description: Above 150 blocks (half an hour) the ProofStuck alert fires.

panels.title: Periodic tasks failing
panels.description: 1 while a task's last run threw: finality sweep, reconciliation, Arweave images, herald.

panels.title: RPC latency by endpoint
panels.description: Worst replica for the API (it reads the economy and claim times), the indexer on its own.

panels.title: RPC calls failed per minute, by endpoint
Replicas up
panels.description: API processes Prometheus finds behind the alias and that answer. API_REPLICAS in /opt/dno/.env sets how many run.

panels.title: Busiest replica's share
panels.description: The proxy keeps each client IP on one replica: with few visitors one can take most of the traffic, with many it evens out.

panels.title: Event loop lag p99, worst replica
panels.description: Above 0.5 s for 10 minutes the ApiEventLoopBlocked alert fires: time for another replica.

panels.title: Restarts, last 24 h
panels.description: Deploys included: each one starts a new set of replicas and the indexer.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Processes per image tag (the commit): two tags only while a deploy runs.

panels.title: Latency p95, by replica
panels.description: Relayer and chat left out: they wait on Zama and Gemini.

panels.title: CPU by process
panels.description: One Node process uses one core at most: near 100% is a full replica.

panels.title: Memory by process
panels.description: Each container is capped at 512 MiB (deploy/docker-compose.yml).

panels.title: Zama relayer proxy calls, by operation and status
panels.description: Per minute. On mainnet each decryption and input is billed to the collection.

panels.title: Herald posts by account and status
Seats taken
panels.description: X accounts with every boarding task done, and wallets that claimed and played the testnet; an X account and its linked wallet count once.

panels.title: Seats filled
panels.description: Out of ALLOW_LIST_PLACES. Full: nobody new gets a seat.

panels.title: Wallet claims
panels.description: Wallets that signed a claim; they sit down once they minted, opened or dueled.

panels.title: Sign in with X
panels.description: ON: X_CLIENT_ID is set. OFF: players prove their account with a post carrying their code.

panels.title: Ideas in the box
panels.description: Read them with GET /v1/ideas?token=ALLOW_LIST_ADMIN_TOKEN.

panels.title: Boarding funnel
panels.description: started: a pass handed out; connected: an X account proved; seated: every required task done; wallet: a wallet linked.

panels.title: Tasks on X declared, by task
panels.description: Declared by the players, checked by hand before mainnet.

panels.title: Sign in with X per hour, by outcome
panels.description: x-down: X refused the code or did not answer; sign-in-refused: the player cancelled on X; list-full: no seat left.

panels.title: NFTs in the vault
panels.description: Sealed, listed on Seaport, or sold with the ETH not yet collected.

panels.title: Seaport volume
panels.description: ETH Seaport buyers paid for vault boxes, listings and accepted offers (test ETH on Sepolia).

panels.title: Private sales settled
panels.description: Their price and whether the box moved stay encrypted.

panels.title: Relayer balance
panels.description: ETH on the vault relayer's wallet (VAULT_RELAYER_KEY): it pays the gas of holders' requests. Below 0.05 the VaultRelayerLow alert fires.

panels.title: Vault boxes by state
panels.description: sealed: in the vault; listed: on Seaport; sold: sold, ETH waiting for the key's holder; withdrawn: the NFT taken out; claimed: sold and collected.

panels.title: Requests placed, by action
panels.description: Withdrawals, listings, unlistings, claims, accepted offers and delegations asked with a box's key; pending ones wait for their KMS proof.

panels.title: Requests settled, by outcome
panels.description: refused: a wrong key, nothing happened; stale: the box changed first (its listing filled or expired); expired: no proof within a day, expired by anyone.

panels.title: Relayed per minute, by transaction and outcome
panels.description: reverted: the vault would refuse it, nothing sent; daily-cap: VAULT_RELAY_PER_DAY reached; failed: the node or the wallet failed (out of gas?).

panels.title: Relayer: sent today against the cap, by replica
Open
panels.description: Open: the fal key and the StudioPacks contract are there, and STUDIO_PAUSED is not set.

panels.title: USDC brought in
panels.description: Paid for packs, straight to the treasury. Test USDC on Sepolia.

panels.title: AI cost, all time
panels.description: Estimated from studio.json's estimatedCostUsd, failed jobs included: check it against fal's bill.

panels.title: Margin
panels.description: USDC brought in minus the estimated AI cost. The StudioLosingMoney alert fires when it stays negative.

panels.title: Today's AI budget used
panels.description: Past it, generation waits for midnight UTC (STUDIO_DAILY_BUDGET_USD).

panels.title: Generations by kind and status
panels.description: failed: unit given back; rejected: refused by the safety checker or past the day's refunds, unit kept.

panels.title: AI spend today against the budget
